welcome.title: Welcome to Gouvra, {{name}}
welcome.body: Gouvra is where your team builds AI agents, runs them and keeps an eye on every step, error and cost.

points.agents: Your agents, the tools they may use and their runs
points.providers: Model providers and their encrypted keys

workspace.title: Name your workspace
workspace.subtitle: Usually your team, company or project. You can rename it any time.

invite.title: Invite your teammates
invite.subtitle: Optional. They'll get an e-mail with a link to join {{workspace}}. You can also invite people later from the workspace settings.
invite.allSent: Invitations sent. Continue when you're ready.

checklist.title: Get your workspace ready
checklist.subtitle: A few steps to your first traced execution.
checklist.completeBody: Optional steps stay available whenever you need them.
checklist.dismissFailed: Couldn't hide the checklist. Try again.
checklist.dismissNoPermission: Only admins and the owner can hide the checklist.
checklist.loadError: The checklist is unavailable right now.

create_workspace.title: Create a workspace
create_workspace.description: The home for your agents, providers and team.

invite_teammate.title: Invite a teammate
invite_teammate.description: Share the workspace and choose what each person can do.

configure_provider.title: Connect a model provider
configure_provider.description: Add a provider such as DeepSeek or Anthropic and choose a default model.

create_agent.title: Create your first agent
create_agent.description: Give it instructions, a model and the tools it may use.

run_execution.title: Run an execution
run_execution.description: Launch your agent and follow its trace live.

fallback.title: Complete “{{name}}”
fallback.description: Finish this step to complete the setup.

checklistStep.title: {{workspace}} is ready
checklistStep.subtitle: Here's what's left before your first traced execution. You'll find this checklist on the overview too.
